mentions.note: led the field home in the 2 miles team race
first Belgrave home in the Senior race; won the "Harry Parker" Memorial Trophy and a replica of the "Finch-Wayte Cup"
T.V.H. relay "A" team, final leg; Brighton relay 7th stage
won 2 miles in 9 min. 42.6 secs.; Achilles' tendon trouble
3rd in the Southern at Aylesford in 1948
absent from Cadogan A.C. team, Middlesex race at Trent Park (Cadogan A.C. team)
handed over to Ted Stimpson in the London to Brighton Relay

photos.c:
Vern Blowfield hands the baton over to Ted who sets off on the second leg of the "News of the World" London to Brighton Relay held on April 19th 1947. The Bels went on to win by over two minutes.
(Editor's note: Actually we have stuck our necks out here, for the same combination of runners were also involved in the first take-over in April 1950, with Ted "running a blinder". No doubt someone will correct us if necessary).
